name: longmemeval
scope: Previously inspected bounded regression; source corpus and label bytes preserved; no independent held-out or full-benchmark claim.
question_selection: First6 source questions in fixed original order; no new model scores used for fixture selection.
distractor_selection: Previously frozen union of evenly spaced positions, literal-query overlap and exact annotated evidence turns; original order preserved.
annotation_method: Exact source question, session, turn ordinal, role and body hash; exact-turn gold is scored separately from session hits.
